case_title: HOLLANDER JOSEPH DBA HOLLANDER DENTAL LAB VS BULLERI RICHARD V DDS

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $725.77 FILED BY HOLLANDER JOSEPH DBA HOLLANDER DENTAL LAB AS TO DEFENDANT BULLERI RICHARD V DDS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-12-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT BULLERI RICHARD V DDS

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HOLLANDER JOSEPH DBA HOLLANDER DENTAL LAB IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT BULLERI RICHARD V DDS STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
